name: forge
description: Forge — AI 3D game asset studio (desktop + Android)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @forge/core && npm run build -w @forge/ui && npm run build -w @forge/desktop && npm run build -w @forge/mobile
scripts.build:core: npm run build -w @forge/core && npm run build -w @forge/ui
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @forge/desktop
scripts.build:mobile: npm run build:core && npm run build -w @forge/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && tsc -p apps/desktop/tsconfig.json && tsc -p apps/mobile/tsconfig.json
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:mobile && npx --workspace @forge/mobile cap sync android
